title: ContraDB's ¶
assumes: The last call of the pass is the one that carries it: the neighbour swing at the end of B2, once for the ones' pass and once for the twos'.
quotes: ContraDB: “8: neighbors swing ⁋” — the last figure of B2, in both halves of the dance.
notes: ContraDB marks the figure that carries the progression with a pilcrow, and Jeremy Corners has one per pass, on B2's neighbour swing. It is the last call of the pass, so this reading puts the shift a beat earlier than the engine's own pass boundary — and the difference is the mechanism, because a call that carries the progression at its end slides the dancers it leaves out along with their own line (M9g) and a boundary does not.
